classReports.title: Class Report - 06 Jun 2026
classReports.summary: The lesson opened with Diego talking about a shortened work week and accumulated time off, then quickly moved into his real professional world: trade marketing, brand relationships, event tickets, company compliance and the responsibilities that come with representing multiple brands. The conversation developed into a reflective career discussion about whether he sees himself moving into coordination or becoming a specialist in beauty and dermocosmetics.
classReports.teacherInsight: Diego sustained long turns, explained complex professional situations without relying on scripted language, and demonstrated strong judgment when discussing brand neutrality, career direction and workplace relationships.

classReports.title: Class Report - 27 Jun 2026
classReports.summary: This lesson moved through everyday culture and Diego's professional expertise in a very natural way. A discussion about the World Cup and time zones led into music, films and entertainment, before Diego took the lead in a detailed conversation about skincare, sunscreen, Asian beauty products and how Brazilian climate and skin needs affect product positioning.
classReports.teacherInsight: Diego was especially effective when teaching/explaining his own field to the teacher. He could connect technical product knowledge with broader market and cultural observations, showing both lexical range and strong conversational stamina.

classReports.title: Class Report - 12 Jul 2026
classReports.summary: The third complete session shows a clear shift toward applied Business English. After a conversational warm-up, Diego discussed a beauty-industry video and reflected on accent, listening difficulty and global business culture. The lesson became a working business-language lab around brand positioning, market trends, target audience, price range, KPIs, omnichannel strategy, CRM, active ingredients, stakeholders and touchpoints.
focus: Business English for beauty and retail
classReports.teacherInsight: Diego could understand the core message of authentic business media even when one speaker's accent was more difficult. He then connected the content to his own market knowledge and explained sophisticated commercial concepts such as KPIs, omnichannel, target audience and brand positioning.

classReports.title: Class Report - 25 Jul 2026
classReports.summary: This class explored workload and professional boundaries, then moved into AI, delegation and the possible impact of automation on jobs. The discussion connected technology with real workplace choices and the need to think critically about how professional roles may change.
classReports.teacherInsight: This lesson added a useful technology-and-work perspective to your portfolio and broadened the range of professional topics you can discuss in English.

grammarOverview.title: Grammar Overview (Cumulative)
grammarOverview.summary: Diego communicates complex professional ideas confidently. The current accuracy goal is to make his English more consistent and concise in high-value business situations.
focusPoints: Auxiliary and subject-verb agreement: stabilize high-frequency forms in spontaneous speech.
Prepositions and compact location/time phrasing: prefer natural professional combinations such as at work and straight to work.
Modal + base verb: use forms such as could understand rather than could understood.
Gerund / infinitive patterns: consolidate prefer to stay, like going and similar frequent structures.
Natural collocations: replace direct Portuguese transfer with internationally natural business phrasing.
Executive sentence framing: compress ideas into claim -> reason -> example -> conclusion.

teacherFeedback.title: Current teacher feedback
teacherFeedback.body: You communicate with confidence and already use English to explain your field, compare options, justify opinions and discuss business strategy. Your communicative ability is currently stronger than your grammatical consistency, which is a positive base for the next stage. The priority now is to keep your fluency while making high-value professional answers more concise, accurate and internationally natural.

teacherFeedback.title: Current growth priority
teacherFeedback.body: Your next classes should focus on a small number of high-impact accuracy targets at a time: agreement, auxiliaries, prepositions, verb patterns and business collocations. Short executive-response practice and delayed correction will help you increase precision without interrupting your conversational momentum.
